hypothesis.statement: When the close of a BINANCE USD-M perpetual falls below SMA(window) x (1 - discount), the short-horizon move is expected to mean-revert upward.
hypothesis.mechanism: oversold deviation from a simple moving average, traded long/flat only
hypothesis.direction: LONG / FLAT only. No short leg, no short mirroring, no silent alpha inversion.
hypothesis.test_statistic: per-cohort (symbol x timeframe): historical-selected winner evaluated on OOS, full window, four execution stress reruns and its historical parameter neighbourhood. The family statistic is the COUNT of cohort survivors, not a cross-cohort median.

eligible_universe.cohort_definition: one cohort = one (symbol, timeframe) pair; the disposition unit of v1.3.0
excluded: 1w (present in raw, outside this family's eligible universe)

domain_provenance.checked_first: Searched the reviewed Hermes records that could carry a stronger, already-audited DCA parameter domain: quant/dca-ladder-bounded-capital-2026-09-03 (+ dca_calculator.py), quant/dca-backtest-stress-execution-2026-09-03, quant/dca-adaptive-signal-gated-regime-2026-09-03, quant/dca-capstone-graduation-2026-09-03, quant/production-dca-p2-*-2026-09-04, quant/binance-usdm-production-dca-venue-contract-2026-09-04.
domain_provenance.finding: Those records register the DCA/scale-in BOUNDEDNESS requirements (finite n_safety, C_max, invalidation, max loss at invalidation), the price/size/breakeven arithmetic and synthetic sweep demonstrations (d0 0.01-0.03 on synthetic bars, k 0.8-2.0). None of them publishes an audited DCA parameter SEARCH DOMAIN, and none registers a domain for this ladder/TP/invalidation family. There is therefore no stronger existing evidence to inherit, and the minimal bounded domain of the card is adopted verbatim (not widened, not narrowed).
declared_differences_from_those_records: the reviewed records describe invalidation as a boundary 'beyond the last safety order'; Strategy A's inherited engine anchors the resting stop on the running average cost (v1 round r2 semantics, kept verbatim here). This is a declared, non-negotiable inheritance of the existing engine, not a new choice made after seeing results.
the reviewed records allow size multipliers k up to 1.5-2.0 on synthetic bars; the user-fixed invariant for this production rail is 1.1 (1.0 for flat sizing), so the domain is {1.0, 1.1}.
domain_provenance.no_post_hoc_resizing: The domain was fixed before any v2 computation and must not be narrowed or widened afterwards (contract 7.2; the card forbids shrinking the DCA domain after seeing results).

selector_and_disposition.selection_protocol: Deterministic, historical window ONLY; OOS must never be used to select parameters.
selection_steps: 1. Sufficiency: if the cohort's best historical case has fewer episodes than gates.min_episodes_is, the cohort is culled with reason insufficient_trades.
2. Eligibility: a case is a candidate iff historical net_pnl > 0 AND historical sharpe > 0 AND historical episodes >= gates.min_episodes_is.
3. If no case is a candidate, the cohort is culled with reason no_qualifying_candidate.

4. Ranking: Sharpe descending, then net_pnl descending, then a fixed lexical tie-break over the REGISTERED INDEX of each axis in the fixed order (window, discount, spacing_pct, size_multiplier, breakeven_tp_pct, invalidation_pct). The first case is the cohort winner.
5. The winner's exact strategy+DCA cell is carried unchanged into OOS, full, every robustness grid and the neighbourhood test. No cell may be swapped after OOS has been seen.
cohort_survivor_requirements: b) OOS: net_pnl > 0 AND sharpe > 0 for the winner's cell
c) full window: net_pnl > 0 for the winner's cell
d) robustness: the SAME winner cell has net_pnl > 0 in each of fee_2x, funding_2x, entry_delay_1_bar, slippage_2ticks

e) parameter neighbourhood: at least 60% of the winner cell's legal face-adjacent neighbours (one +-1 step on exactly one registered axis, in-domain) agree with the winner's historical net-PnL sign. The neighbourhood judgement uses HISTORICAL rows only - never OOS.

family_disposition.1 cohort survivor: SURVIVOR_FOUND (verdict PASS; performance_claimable still requires the full contract 9.6 condition set)
family_disposition.>1 cohort survivors: MULTIPLE_SURVIVORS (verdict FINALIST: the research threshold is met, but selecting among survivors is a downstream/operator decision, so performance_claimable stays false)
family_disposition.coverage or technical incompleteness: TECHNICAL_INCOMPLETE (no cohort is judged at all)

selector_and_disposition.cross_cohort_medians: descriptive diagnostics only; median historical/full PnL or Sharpe across the 20 cohorts (or across all base cases) is NOT a gate and must not be converted into one.

data.split_immutability: The split is fixed here, before any computation, and must not be moved afterwards.
data.derived_store: Built per attempt from raw into the rebuildable /qlib/work area via upstream qlib dump_bin.py; read back exclusively through the qlib data layer. Never written to /results. Bars are never resampled or gap-filled: a missing bar stays missing.

costs.source: canonical instrument metadata (raw binance/usdm/instruments/usdm-perp-instruments.json), read at run time, never hard-coded
costs.apply_rule: every fill is a market order: taker fee on the full traded notional, plus adverse slippage of baseline_slippage_ticks instrument ticks (1 tick = price_increment). No maker fills are assumed anywhere.
costs.baseline_slippage_provenance: research assumption of this round (NOT user-specified); robustness re-measures it at 2 ticks
costs.funding: actual funding from /data/raw binance/usdm/funding/<SYMBOL>/<SYMBOL>-funding.jsonl.gz, filtered to truth_status == "official". Intervals without an official observation carry zero funding cost; coverage is disclosed in the artifacts and re-measured by the no_funding / no_funding_full diagnostics.
costs.funding_immutability: The official-funding baseline must not be swapped for a modelled series to improve the outcome.

dca_execution_semantics.authorization: Inherited verbatim from Strategy A v1 round r2 (card t_97208408); v1.3.0 parametrises the four DCA axes but does not re-interpret the execution semantics.
dca_execution_semantics.trigger_anchoring_resolution: PROVISIONAL_INHERITED_POLICY - the LADDER is anchored on the INITIAL ENTRY FILL PRICE.
dca_execution_semantics.invalidation_anchoring: The rail names the take profit 'breakeven-anchored', i.e. anchored on the average cost of the open book. The invalidation is anchored on the SAME reference (running average cost).

user_fixed_invariants.side: LONG-side mirror/application to this LONG/FLAT alpha

dca_axis_role.spacing_pct: fixed ladder spacing d0: level_k price = initial_entry_price x (1 - spacing_pct x k), k = 1..10
dca_axis_role.size_multiplier: geometric size multiplier k of the rail: level_k margin = base_quote x size_multiplier^k
dca_axis_role.breakeven_tp_pct: reduce-only take profit at running_average_cost x (1 + breakeven_tp_pct)
dca_axis_role.invalidation_pct: RESTING stop at running_average_cost x (1 - invalidation_pct)

engine_semantics.signal: oversold_t := close_t < SMA_window(close)_t x (1 - discount), where SMA_window is the mean of the last `window` closes INCLUDING bar t
engine_semantics.entry: edge-triggered while flat: a fresh oversold crossing (bar t oversold, bar t-1 not oversold). Re-arm requires the condition to be false for at least one bar.
engine_semantics.sizing: non-compounding fixed-quote basis on the pre-registered starting equity: level k margin = base_quote x size_multiplier^k (k = 0..10). Level notional = margin x 10.
engine_semantics.take_profit: reduce-only full flatten of the whole episode when the bar high >= running_average_cost x (1 + breakeven_tp_pct)
engine_semantics.invalidation: a RESTING stop at running_average_cost x (1 - invalidation_pct), anchored on the same breakeven reference as the take profit
engine_semantics.intrabar_ordering: Descending-price trigger walk with the bar LOW reached first, then the bar HIGH. Walking down from the bar open, the next trigger is whichever of the next ladder level and the resting stop is HIGHER. Ladder levels below the resting stop are never reachable. The stop fills at min(stop price, bar open) - a gap through the stop cannot fill at the stop price. Deterministic and never flattering.
engine_semantics.capital_exhaustion: backstop only: forced full flatten at the bar close if unrealised equity <= margin_maint x notional. Evaluated after the down-walk and after the resting stop.
engine_semantics.concurrency: one position episode at a time; no new entry while a position is open; no pyramiding beyond the ladder; no short side

metrics_definitions.equity: 30000 + cumulative realised net PnL (USDT); unrealised marked at bar closes
metrics_definitions.daily_series: end-of-UTC-day equity marks, forward-filled across flat stretches
metrics_definitions.sharpe: mean/std (ddof=1) of daily returns x sqrt(365); risk-free 0
metrics_definitions.max_dd: peak-to-trough of the daily equity series, reported in % and USDT
metrics_definitions.cagr: (ending_equity / 30000) ^ (1/years) - 1, years from the actual bar span
metrics_definitions.max_effective_leverage: max of (position notional / unrealised equity), sampled every in-market bar
metrics_definitions.capital_utilization: mean of (deployed margin / unrealised equity) over in-market bars
metrics_definitions.dca_layer_histogram: count of fills per ladder level, aggregated over all full-window base cases of all 20 cohorts (11,520 cases). Direct evidence of how much of the 12-tranche rail is reachable under resting-stop sequencing.
metrics_definitions.cohort_winner: the historical-only selector output for that (symbol, timeframe) cohort (selector_and_disposition.selection_steps)

items.name: parameter-neighbourhood robustness
items.method: for each cohort winner, compare the winner's historical net-PnL sign against its legal face-adjacent neighbours in the full 576-point joint space (window, discount, spacing_pct, size_multiplier, breakeven_tp_pct, invalidation_pct); require >= 60% sign agreement; historical rows only

items.name: execution stress reruns
items.method: full-window evaluation of all 576 joint cells per cohort under fee_2x, funding_2x, entry_delay_1_bar, slippage_2ticks; the winner's cell must stay net_pnl > 0 in all four

items.name: funding baseline diagnostics
items.method: no_funding (historical window) and no_funding_full (full window) grids for all 576 cells per cohort; DESCRIPTIVE ONLY in v1.3.0 - a cross-cohort funding median is not a gate

items.name: cross-cohort disposition
items.method: the 20 cohort verdicts are the family result; the count of survivors drives the disposition. Cross-cohort medians are reported but never gate

gates.G1_coverage: every one of the 9 registered phase grids must contain exactly 11,520 cases (20 cohorts x 12 strategy cases x 48 DCA configs), each cohort must contain exactly 576 cases per grid, and the measured strategy/DCA cell sets must equal the registered cartesian products; otherwise TECHNICAL_INCOMPLETE and no cohort is judged
gates.G2_insufficient_trades: per cohort only: fewer than min_episodes_is historical episodes in the cohort's best case culls THAT cohort (insufficient_trades) and never affects another cohort
gates.G3_cohort_selector: per cohort: historical net_pnl > 0 AND sharpe > 0 AND episodes >= min_episodes_is, ranked by Sharpe desc, net_pnl desc, registered-index lexical tie-break
gates.G4_cohort_oos: per cohort winner: OOS net_pnl > 0 AND OOS sharpe > 0
gates.G6_cohort_robustness: per cohort winner: net_pnl > 0 in all four execution stress reruns
gates.G7_cohort_neighbourhood: per cohort winner: >= 60% of legal face-adjacent neighbours agree in historical net-PnL sign
gates.verdict_rule: TECHNICAL_INCOMPLETE if G1 fails; else the count of cohorts passing G3-G7 decides: 0 -> REJECT, 1 -> PASS, >1 -> FINALIST. No post-hoc threshold edits, no tuning to pass.
gates.known_gate_set_limitation: The registered gate set contains no benchmark-relative test. A long-only strategy can show positive cohort PnL purely through the sample's upward drift. This limitation is declared BEFORE the run and is NOT patched afterwards; a buy-and-hold comparison remains a non-gating diagnostic.

falsification: no signal / insufficient trades in a cohort (G2; culls that cohort only)
no qualifying historical candidate in a cohort (G3)
OOS economic rejection for a cohort winner (G4)
full-window economic rejection for a cohort winner (G5)
robustness economic failure for a cohort winner (G6)
parameter-neighbourhood fragility for a cohort winner (G7)
DCA execution incomplete or not true order-fill accounting (see assertions.json; any false assertion = TECHNICAL_INCOMPLETE)
coverage incomplete in any registered phase grid (G1)
performance_claimable_rule: true only when the family verdict == PASS (exactly one cohort survivor) and contract 9.6 holds (canonical raw, no look-ahead, explicit OOS, declared costs, full section 7.2 coverage including the DCA parameter domain). Downstream authoritative acceptance is out of scope and is never a precondition.

expected.arithmetic: 20 cohorts x 12 strategy cases x 48 DCA configs = 11520 base combinations per phase grid; x 9 phase grids = 103680 full case evaluations. A case evaluation = one engine simulation of one joint parameter cell of one cohort on one phase grid.

runtime_expectation.basis: Strategy A v1 (card t_97208408) measured 2160 case evaluations in ~35 s of engine time inside qlib-run (result.json runtime_seconds=75 including a 40.2 s bin-store rebuild).
runtime_expectation.estimate: ~103680 / 2160 x 35 s ~ 28 minutes of engine time, i.e. ~30-35 minutes including the bin rebuild.
runtime_expectation.status: estimate only, extrapolated from the audited v1 throughput; not a guarantee, not validated by a v2 run. The card is parked in 'scheduled' while the container computes, so no worker turn is occupied.

non_goals: no parameter search beyond the registered strategy grid and the registered DCA domain
no OOS-based selection of any parameter
no legacy Nautilus runtime, gate or performance truth
no narrowing of the eligible universe on the basis of v1's 4h-only positive cohorts
